text: Your recalled statement of the theorem is not evidence and cannot be a deliverable here. The one result on this problem that recall cannot supply is exact values: you have f(1..4)=1,2,2,2 by enumeration, and f(5) onward needs the decision problem posed to a SAT or ILP solver rather than subsets enumerated. Push f_exact as far as the solver will go, record the runtime at the last n completed, and report the degree distributions of the optimal sets, not only the maxima. A computed f(5), f(6) is a genuinely new number; a restatement of a remembered bound is not.
